book.name: Matayu
book.title: Nhalo ghwa maha handa paghutyekitwe na Matayu

content: Yesu kangulongea kulinga nhalo ghwa kulekana
Yesu pakayomolite kulongela malagho agho, kakibhuka Galilaya na kakighenda ku Yudea, kumwambo ya lukemba lwa Yoludani.
Lumati lukulu lwa bhandu lukinntughila, naywo Yesu kakialamiha ukwaku ako.
Amoo bha Afaliayu bhaknhikila bhankonye kyakuntegha, “Bhuli, yibhegha tela kwa nngwana kumpegha nhumbu ywake lihamba lya kulekana kwa nnando ghwohele?”
Yesu kakiayanga, “Bhuli, mukisoma ng'obhe mumalemba gha Chapanga kukita kundandila makachu apo, Chapanga kakiabhumba mundu nngwana, na mundu nhumbu.
Chapanga kakilongela, ‘Kya habhu, mundu katanneka tate ywake na mama ywake naywo bhaalungana na nhumbu ywake na abho abhili bhaabhegha mmili ghumu.’
Habhu, abho chepa abhili kangi, ngati abhegha mmili ghumu. Kya abhu kila kyakakilungite Chapanga, mundu kakotoke kughabhaniha.”
Peni bhombe bhakinkonya, “Kiyaha niki Musa kakilaghila kukita mundu katanpegha nhumbu ywake lihamba lya kuleka na kunneka?”
Yesu kakiayanga, “Musa kakiategheka kualeka ahumbu bhenu kubhukana na unonopo ghwa myoyo yenu. Peni kutandila makachu yikibhegha habhu ng'obhe.

Nenga nunguaghombela, mundu ywohele ywakanneka nhumbu ywake, manipangi kwa kutenda utyahe ghweka, pakatolela nhumbu yungi aywo kangutenda utyahe. Naywo ywakatolela yula nhumbu ywakalekitwi kangutenda utyahe ubhwabhu abhu.”
Ahundwa bhake bhakinng'ombela, “Handa milando yene ndo habhu kwa nngwana na nhumbu, mbaha mundu kakotoke kutolela.”
Yesu kakiaghombela, “Chepa bhandu bhoha bhanakuhotola kulikingama lilagho ali, ngati kwa bhala ghweka bhanakutangatilwa na Chapanga kutenda habhu.

Mana kubhegha bhaaponekiliywe na lukuhu kiyaha abhelekwa habhu, bhangi atendwa habhu na bhandu, na bhangi bhalitenda habhu kwakya Ghubhutwa ghwa kunane. Ywombe ywakahotola kulikingama lilagho ali na kalikingame.”
Yesu kanguanonela bhana adoko
Mbole, amoo bhandu bhakennyeghela Yesu bhana adoko ngati kabhayabhikile mabhoko ghake mu mitwe yabhe na kubhayupila. Peni ahundwa bhake bhakialakalila bhala bhaabhayeghite bhana.
Yesu kakilongela, “Mualekeke bhana adoko ahike kwa nenga, nkotoke kuakanikiha, kiyaha Ghubhutwa ghwa Kunane ndo ghwa bhala bhaabheghite handa bhana abha.”
Naywo kakiayabhikila mabhoko ghake mu mitwe yabhe, mbole, kakibhuka akwo.
Nhongolo yunautopelo
Mundu yumu kakinhikila Yesu na kakinkonya, “Nhunda ywa maha, ndende nnando ghani ghwa maha ngati mokole ubhumi ghwa manjubha ghoha kyanga uhiko?”
Yesu kakinng'ombela, “Kiyaha niki ghungungema ywa maha? Kahone ywakabhegha ywa maha nga Chapanga ghweka chake. Peni paghupala kuyingila mu ubhumi ghuyitikile ngwilikiho.”
Yula mundu kakinkonya, “Ngwilikiho hyoki?” Yesu kakinnyanga, “Kukoma kata, utyahe kata, kuyibha kata, uyimiho ghwa uhwangi kata,
ghubhayitikile tate ywako na mama ywako, na ghunpale nnyako handa paghulipala ghumwene.”
Yula nhongolo kakinng'ombela, “Agha ghoha nighakamula kala, ndende niki kangi?”

Yesu kakinng'ombela, “Handa paghupala kubhegha ntwihiiko, ghughende ghukahemengane hilibhi hyoha highubheghite nahyo na ngalabha ahyo ghukaapeghe kapukwa, na ghwabhegha na utopelo ghwa kunane kwa Chapanga, mbole ghuhike ghundughile.”
Yula nhongolo pakayihwite agho, kakighenda kunu pakahyongoloka, kiyaha kakibhegha na utopelo ntangalo.
Ndo Yesu kakiaghombela ahundwa bhake, “Kulyaghila nunguaghombela, yabhegha unonopo kwa yunautopelo kuyingila mu Ghubhutwa ghwa kunanie kwa Chapanga.
Nungubhuyila kuaghombela, yabhegha uyeyebhu kwa nnyama ywakakemwa ngamia kupita mu lilanga lya sasia peni chepa kwa yunautopelo kuyingila mu Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga.”
Ahundwa bhake paayihwite agho bhakikangacha munu na bhakinkonya, “Ndo ghani hino kaahotola kulopoka?”
Peni Yesu kakialolekeha na kakiaghombela. “Kwa anabhandu nnando aghu ghwaahotoleka kata, peni kwa Chapanga milando hyoha yinguhotoleka.”
Ndo Petili kakinnyanga, “Ghulole, twenga tuhileka hyoha na kughutughila ghwenga, twaamokola niki?”

Yesu kakiaghombela, “Kulyaghila nunguaghombela, Mwana ywa Mundu pakapala kutama mukiteho kyake kya Utabhala kya ukulu mu unnima ghwa hyono, mwenga mundughilite maatama mu hiteho kumi na ibhili pamuatosa kabila kumi na ibhili hya Isilaeli.

Na ywohele ywakalekite nyumba ebu nnongo ebu nhacha ebu tate ebu mama ghwake ebu bhana bhake ebu mighunda, kwakya nenga, katamokola mala mia yimu kuchweha, na katapeghwa ubhumi ghwa manjubha ghoha ghangapela.
Peni atangalo bhaabheghite bha kalongohi bhaabhegha bha uhiko na bhaabheghite bha uhiko bhabhegha bha kalongohi.”
